sessions.phase_label: Access handoff and technical scope refinement

requirements.title: Avelin AI Provider Policy
requirements.definition: Use the existing Avelin AI integration for platform AI workflows and exclude OpenAI from the production implementation.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a cross-cutting provider constraint that can change independently from the behavior of mood boards, retrieval, or selfie styling.

requirements.title: Styling Agent Response Enhancement
requirements.definition: Improve the Styling Agent's prompts, response structure, and presented results within the existing agent flow.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers general Styling Agent prompt and result quality; mood-board generation and shopping-link retrieval have separate outputs and acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: AI Styling Mood Board Generation
requirements.definition: Allow users to prompt the Styling Agent to generate complete fashion mood boards through Avelin AI and present the generated result in the existing interface.
requirements.boundary_note: Backend prompting, response formatting, and UI presentation are coupled implementation dimensions of one generated mood-board behavior.

requirements.title: Expanded Fashion Web Retrieval
requirements.definition: Improve agent retrieval so results include more relevant fashion sources and shopping links.
requirements.boundary_note: Source expansion and shopping-link return are attributes of one retrieval mechanism, while generated mood boards remain independently testable.

requirements.title: Selfie Styling Capability Evaluation
requirements.definition: Prompt Avelin AI through the backend with selfie-styling inputs, produce image outputs, and submit the results for quality review before deciding whether to build the complete feature.
requirements.boundary_note: The independently requested deliverable is the backend evaluation and review output; a production selfie-styling feature is excluded until the client makes the contingent development decision.

requirements.title: Per-Account AI Usage Ledger
requirements.definition: Record Avelin AI consumption in Supabase by user account, agent, prompt type, token usage, and estimated cost.
requirements.boundary_note: The tracked dimensions are attributes of one usage-ledger mechanism; credit balances, subscription entitlements, and payment processing are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Credit-Based Usage System
requirements.definition: Represent and enforce AI usage through account-level credits derived from tracked consumption.
requirements.boundary_note: Credit accounting is independently enforceable from raw usage measurement, subscription-tier configuration, and Stripe payment processing.

requirements.title: Usage-Based Subscription Tiers
requirements.definition: Provide multiple subscription tiers with different prompt or usage limits based on measured Avelin AI consumption.
requirements.boundary_note: Tier limits and usage-derived pricing form one entitlement mechanism; collecting payments and maintaining credit balances can evolve independently.

requirements.title: Stripe Payment Integration
requirements.definition: Integrate Stripe payment APIs to support the platform's paid subscription plans.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers payment-provider integration only; usage measurement, credit accounting, and subscription limits are independently changing requirements.

requirements.title: Google Analytics 4 Integration
requirements.definition: Integrate Google Analytics 4 tracking across the platform.
requirements.boundary_note: GA4 has a provider-specific implementation and can be enabled, modified, or verified independently from other analytics tools.

requirements.title: Microsoft Clarity Integration
requirements.definition: Integrate Microsoft Clarity behavior analytics across the platform.
requirements.boundary_note: Clarity has an independent provider integration and verification path from GA4 and attribution tooling.

requirements.title: Affiliate and Campaign Attribution Tracking
requirements.definition: Integrate two or three additional analytics or attribution tools for affiliate marketing and campaign tracking.
requirements.boundary_note: The exact additional tools are unresolved parameters of one attribution objective; GA4 and Clarity are explicitly named independent integrations.

requirements.title: Showroom and Concierge Journey Clarity
requirements.definition: Make the connected showroom and concierge flow easier for users and investors to understand and navigate.
requirements.boundary_note: The current evidence frames showroom and concierge as one connected explanatory journey; split them later only if screen-specific requirements or independent trajectories emerge.

requirements.title: Website UI and Copy Updates
requirements.definition: Apply the requested minor user-interface and frontend text changes throughout the platform.
requirements.boundary_note: The available history establishes a real UI and copy obligation but does not yet provide enough screen-specific detail for defensible splitting.

requirements.title: Shopline App Store Widget
requirements.definition: Develop a Shopline App Store widget that retrieves its primary content from the existing GIA platform.
requirements.boundary_note: OAuth, product/content APIs, publishing, webhooks, and review compliance are currently integration dimensions of one widget rather than separately confirmed product behaviors.

requirements.title: Obsolete Backend Repository Cleanup
requirements.definition: Delete obsolete backend versions from the project's repository set when repository changes are authorized.
requirements.boundary_note: Repository deletion is a concrete cleanup obligation distinct from the rule governing where active development work may occur.

requirements.title: MVP Repository Development Isolation
requirements.definition: Confine current development to the designated MVP frontend and backend repositories and perform changes on separate working branches.
requirements.boundary_note: This requirement governs active development isolation; deleting obsolete repository versions is a separate action with its own lifecycle.
